title: Free Roaming Chickens | Everyday Life in St Thomas
description: you stop noticing the chickens after a few days in the virgin islands, until a visitor points at one mid sentence and you remember how unusual it actually looks. this rooster and hen wandering past a fishing supply shop, palm trees swaying overhead, is just an ordinary tuesday here. #stthomas #usvi #islandlife
alt_text: rooster and hen walking on grass outside a blue door fishing supply shop with palm trees, St Thomas

title: Rooster and Hen by the Marina | St Thomas Wildlife
description: a closer look at the same pair, pecking around near the marina steps like they own the place, which honestly they kind of do. free roaming chickens are practically part of the landscape in the caribbean and i never get tired of finding them somewhere unexpected. #stthomas #usvi #caribbeanwildlife
alt_text: rooster and hen near marina shop steps and black railing, St Thomas

title: Beach View Through Sea Grape Trees | St Thomas USVI
description: framed by sea grape leaves, this is the kind of beach moment you almost walk past without noticing, sand scattered with dried leaves, a boat anchored in turquoise water, hills rolling out toward the horizon. some of the best caribbean views aren't the wide open ones, they're the ones you catch through a gap in the trees. #stthomas #usvi #caribbeanbeaches
alt_text: beach and turquoise water framed by sea grape tree branches with anchored boat, St Thomas

title: Sea Birds on Rocky Outcrop | Caribbean Coastal Wildlife
description: a small rock formation just offshore, claimed entirely by cormorants drying their wings in the sun. these little wildlife moments are easy to miss if you're focused on the water itself, but they're some of my favorite parts of island mornings. #usvi #stthomas #caribbeanwildlife
alt_text: cormorants perched on a rocky outcrop in turquoise Caribbean water

title: Marlin Sculpture Marina Entrance | St Thomas Sportfishing
description: you know you're at a real sportfishing marina when there's a giant blue marlin sculpture arched over the entrance like a gateway. sailboats and sportfishing yachts lined up below it, dock stretching out into blue sky, this felt like the unofficial welcome sign of the harbor. #stthomas #usvi #caribbeanmarina
alt_text: blue marlin sculpture arch over marina dock with sportfishing yachts, St Thomas

title: Cormorants on the Rocks | Wider View of the Reef Outcrop
description: same little rock island, different angle, same group of cormorants holding their spots like they've got reservations. the water out here shifts from pale turquoise to deep blue in just a few feet, which never stops being satisfying to look at. #usvi #stthomas #caribbeanocean
alt_text: wide view of cormorants on a rocky outcrop with turquoise to deep blue water gradient

title: Lionfish Derby Shirt at the Marina | St Thomas St John Water Island
description: standing at the dock in a lionfish derby shirt, marlin sculpture looming overhead, sportfishing boats lined up behind. events like this one across st thomas, st john, and water island turn a real conservation problem into a community day on the water, and i love that the shirts make it look this good. #lionfishderby #stthomas #usvi
alt_text: person wearing St Thomas St John Water Island Lionfish Derby shirt standing on marina dock under marlin sculpture

title: Quiet Beach and Boat | St Thomas Coastal Calm
description: some days the whole point is just this, a small boat sitting still on flat turquoise water, green hills rolling along the coast, leaves scattered at your feet. no agenda, just a quiet beach moment in the us virgin islands. #stthomas #usvi #caribbeanbeaches
alt_text: small boat on calm turquoise water with green coastal hills, viewed through beach leaves, St Thomas

title: Hundreds of Dollar Bills on a Bar Ceiling | USVI Tradition
description: step back and the scale of it hits you, hundreds of dollar bills layered across the ceiling beams, each one someone's tiny souvenir of a night here. names, dates, inside jokes scrawled in marker, it's a strange kind of community wall built one dollar at a time. #usvi #stthomas #caribbeanbar
alt_text: wide shot of hundreds of signed dollar bills covering wooden ceiling beams at a bar in USVI

title: Lionfish Spines Removed | Derby Cleaning Process
description: this pile of spines is the part nobody talks about when they talk about eating lionfish. removed carefully, laid out on a cutting board, each one still capable of delivering a painful sting even separated from the fish. it's a small reminder of how much respect this invasive species still demands, even after it's caught. #lionfishderby #stthomas #usvi
alt_text: pile of removed venomous lionfish spines on a cutting board surface
